description: Remove one line item from a job. The job stays; its total and derived description follow from what is left on it. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. A job's line-item list also carries rows Housecall Pro added itself, an automatic tax line among them, so check what a row is before touching it rather than working through the whole list. Nothing is sent to the customer by itself, though a customer who opens an invoice they were already sent sees the new figure.
name: hcp_delete_job_line_item
